Definition: from G1909 and G4496; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):--cast upon.
BiblicalUsage: Epirrhipto means to cast upon — to throw a burden onto another. The disciples cast their garments upon the colt and set Jesus thereon; and Peter says, casting all your care upon Him, for He careth for you.
TheologicalSignificance: Garments cast on the colt for the King, and cares cast on the King for us: both are acts of trust, and the two castings belong together.
